description: Makita HR2663 1" SDS-PLUS AVT® Rotary Hammer, w/HEPA Dust Extractor (D-handle) - Distributed/Packaged by Makita. Product Details: The Makita 1" SDS-PLUS AVT® Rotary Hammer, HEPA Dust Extractor with D-Handle (HR2663) is a total solution that combines efficient drilling and chipping with reduced vibration and improved dust extraction.The HR2663 is equipped with Anti-Vibration Technology (AVT®), an internal counterbalance system for significantly less vibration. It has a built-on dust extractor that captures concrete dust during drilling. HR2653 combines these performance features in a compact size. It is ideal for a range of applications including overhead drilling into concrete, wood, and metal, removing tile, and more.The HEPA Dust Extractor is OSHA Table 1 compliant for Exposure to Respirable Crystalline Silica (rule 1926.1153). The OSHA Table 1 compliant on-board dust extractor includes a filter cleaning mechanism designed to help maintain optimum suction efficiency. The dust extractor is activated by the tool for operator convenience and is equipped with an efficient HEPA filtration system that captures 99.97% of particulates .3 microns and larger. It has a transparent dust container with an accurate level indicator of collected material for added convenience.The HR2663 has an 8 AMP motor that delivers 2.1 ft.lbs. of impact energy to handle the most demanding applications. The 3-mode operation offers “rotation only”, “hammering with rotation” or “chipping only” for multiple applications. Modes can be easily changed with a recessed hammer-function selector, which is located below the gear housing for improved durability.Convenience features include an ergonomic pistol grip handle with a rubberized soft grip provides increased operator comfort. There is a retractable hook that allows the tool to remain close by but never in the way. It also features a depth stop adjustment that allows drilling up to 7-1/2" deep for increased capacity.

specifications.Included Components: Dust Extractor Attachment with HEPA Filter Cleaning Mechanism (127190-5); Dust Case with HEPA Filter Cleaning Mechanism (199587-8); Tool Case
